content.value: An optical fiber has a core refractive index of 1.5. Two lengths of the fibers with (06) smooth and perpendicular end faces are butted together. Assuming the fiber axes are perfectly aligned. Calculate the total optical loss in decibels at the joint due to Fresnel reflection when there is a small air gap between the fiber and faces.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
